interpretation: Five-image generated-caption smoke test. Prefilter-only blocking is easy to integrate but can route a denied object to a new unsupported COCO object. Bounded iterative expansion adds that substitute and removes the new hallucinated object route, but hard blocking and soft penalty 4 still leave an incomplete caption on the stress image. Soft penalty 1 is too weak and leaves the original bird hallucination unchanged. Offline sentence-level repair removes incomplete trailing fragments and further reduces CHAIRi on the 5-image smoke, but it shortens several captions because the smoke run uses a 64-token cap. The next method should implement sentence-level stop/repair or constrained rewrite after dynamic replacement verification, then evaluate at a less truncated generation budget.
